allow: PowerShell(foreach \($c in 'node','npm','git','docker'\) { $cmd = Get-Command $c -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($cmd\) { "$c : " + \(& $c --version\) } else { "$c : not found" } })

PowerShell("ANTHROPIC_API_KEY set: " + [bool]$env:ANTHROPIC_API_KEY; $a = Get-Command ant -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($a\) { ant auth status } else { "ant CLI: not found" }; "supabase CLI: " + [bool]\(Get-Command supabase -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue\); "vercel CLI: " + [bool]\(Get-Command vercel -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue\))
